pull_request.title: Infrastructure: encapsulate DD4hep detector sources independently of ACTS
pull_request.head: codex/software-detectors
pull_request.body:
Second migration step, based on #77 and ADR-008. Moves existing detector factories/configuration into software/source/detectors, including the existing strip and calorimeter prototype factories. The component configures directly without ACTS; root CMake retains the historical build/dd4hep/detector output path. Relative compatibility symlinks preserve source hashes, older tools and retained evidence links.

Validation: before/after full detector builds passed; all 16 tracker XML files are byte-identical and all 680,292 native entity records match. All five factory libraries built in a direct standalone configuration. The full DD4hep/export/ROOT regression suite passed 10/10, including the complete tracker audit. Session/project/token validators and token preview build passed. The stage-two commit records the full audit as pending at commit time; it completed successfully afterward and the final migration record will retain that result.

No detector dimensions, materials, IDs, layouts or accepted reference evidence are changed. The default factory build remains independent of ACTS. Merge after #77.

events.text:
This is an Infrastructure and SW task:

- leave depencency locally bound to acts-mac-studio to the spack acts ci-depenencies
- make sure that in nodd we have a folder/directory for the software with (whereever possible gitmodules)
  - then `software/submodules`
    - make ACTS a git submodule of this folder
    - make IdRes a submodule  
    - make nodehammer a submodule 
    - make ... whatever you had prepared already a submodule 
  - then actual `software/source` for source code
    - our event processing framework for this should still be ActsExamples, however additional Algorithms go into the `sofware/source/ActsExamples` locally and not into the checked out Acts repo (currently acts-nodd) 
    - necessary glue code to work with externals should go here
    - DD4hep code for building the detector should go here, `software/source/detectors`, the ACTS related part can go into `sofware/source/ActsExamples` the DD4hep part should be self-contained
    - Additional EDM should go here etc. 
  - then steering and running `software/running`
    - python based steering files for doing jobs
  - then analysis `software/analysis`



Create the Makefiles for this and a number of PRs that set this up step by step to arrive at the same functionality you have right now (including `acts-nodd`).



The objective is:

- updating Acts would be a single git submodule operation (and would not touch code specific to nodd), if updates to nodd-code are needed after an ACTS code update this can be tested
- detector code is independent and can be encapsulated 



Ask if something is not clear.
